subject: CEntity flag bits — the complete m_nFlags and m_nStatus bit-field layout
overview: Every CEntity (building, vehicle, ped, object, dummy) carries two 32-bit flag words: m_nStatus (entity lifecycle state, 8 bits) and m_nFlags (bitfield of ~32 behaviour flags). These are the most-touched bytes in the entire game engine. Many are set during streaming load and cleared on unload; others are set during gameplay (vehicle is on fire, ped is dead, building is damaged). This file documents the full confirmed set.

m_nStatus_enum.description: m_nStatus at offset +0x50 (in CEntity). An 8-bit value encoding the entity's current lifecycle state. Used by the streaming and AI systems.
m_nStatus_enum.offset_in_CEntity: 0x50 (part of the m_nFlags field group — exact byte varies by subclass)

STATUS_SIMPLE.description: Simplified (no AI), used for distant LOD vehicles

STATUS_ABANDONED.description: Vehicle abandoned by player, will despawn after timeout

STATUS_PLAYER_REMOTE.description: Remote-controlled (RC car, plane) — player controlling remotely

m_nFlags_bitfield.description: m_nFlags is a 32-bit word at a fixed offset in CEntity (exact offset depends on subclass size). Each bit is accessed by name throughout the engine via inline accessor methods.

bit_1.name: bCollisionProcessed
bit_1.description: Collision was processed this frame (cleared each frame)

bit_2.name: bIsStatic
bit_2.description: Static entity — never moves, can skip physics update

bit_3.name: bHasContacted
bit_3.description: Has had a collision contact this frame

bit_4.name: bPedPhysics
bit_4.description: Use ped capsule physics instead of box/sphere

bit_5.name: bIsStuck
bit_5.description: Physics solver flagged this entity as stuck in geometry

bit_6.name: bIsInSafePosition
bit_6.description: Was found safe by the unstuck resolver

bit_7.name: bUseCollisionRecords
bit_7.description: Keep a history of collision contacts for de-penetration

bit_8.name: bHasHitWall
bit_8.description: Hit a wall or static object this frame

bit_10.name: bIsVisible
bit_10.description: Entity is rendered this frame (set by frustum cull)

bit_11.name: bHasCollided
bit_11.description: Participated in a collision event this frame

bit_17.name: bOnlyDamagedByPlayer
bit_17.description: Takes damage only from the local player entity

bit_18.name: bStreamingDontDelete
bit_18.description: Streaming will not remove this entity automatically

bit_19.name: bRemoveFromWorld
bit_19.description: Entity is marked for removal next update

bit_20.name: bHasHitWall2
bit_20.description: Second wall-hit flag (used to prevent double processing)

bit_21.name: bImBeingRendered
bit_21.description: Entity is mid-render — prevents re-entrant streaming

bit_22.name: bDrawLast
bit_22.description: Force render in the last alpha pass

bit_23.name: bDistanceFade
bit_23.description: Apply alpha fade at far LOD transition distance

bit_24.name: bDontCastShadowsOn
bit_24.description: Do not cast shadows onto this entity surface

bit_26.name: bIsStaticWaitingForCollision
bit_26.description: Static entity awaiting COL load before physics is enabled

bit_27.name: bDontStream
bit_27.description: Keep this entity loaded regardless of distance (mission-critical)

bit_28.name: bUnderwater
bit_28.description: Entity is currently underwater (used for audio/visual effects)

bit_30.name: bIsTouching
bit_30.description: Is touching another entity right now

bit_31.name: bIsSubway
bit_31.description: Part of an interior-tunnel subway node (special render clip)
